title: feat(plugin-tree,plugin-map,types): object-tree and object-map are judged and publish the keys their renderers honour (objectui#11168 slice 3)
body:
Refs #11168

Clause-②: yes (narrowing). It widens: `object-tree` publishes `data`, `staticData`, `filter` and `navigation`; `object-map` publishes `mapStyle`, `navigation` and `enableClustering`; `ObjectTreeSchema.objectName` goes optional; `UIActionSchema.size` admits `default` and `icon`. It narrows: on `ObjectTreeSchema` the keys `data` (now `ViewData`), `tree`, `navigation` and `staticData` used to ride the node's passthrough unjudged, and each is now judged on both faces. The fixed group ships it as `minor`.

objectui#11168 slice 3, part 1 of 2. Decision 3 = B of objectui#11111 applies (record `5902351047`): every key is decided by its own measurement through the real `SchemaRenderer`, and only what the renderer honours is declared. Part 2 is the `object-form.layout` / objectui#7759 Group C narrowing, opened as a separate PR at the PM seat's split boundary.

## What this PR takes

| Block / booking | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| `object-tree` | Loaded into the parity guard and judged. Four keys declared; `objectName` no longer required; the `ObjectTreeSchema` mirror aligned on both faces (pointer `5909523766`, and the `tree` DECLARE verdict owed in the 8655 header) |
| `object-map` | Loaded and judged. Three keys declared |
| `UIActionSchema.size` (booking `5923506054` item 1) | Takes the `action:button` row's vocabulary by reference |
| Calendar pin text (booking item 2) | `allDayField` is a spec key since 17.5.0; the text now says five keys |
| Timeline `navigation` description (record `5924396134`) | Both wording nits corrected, and the same in the docs table |

**Handed back as a worklist**, at a block boundary, to keep this reviewable: `object-gantt` and `object-timeline`. They stay booked OWED in `UNJUDGED_SPEC_BLOCKS`. The `object-timeline.navigation` `MEMBER_PINS` line waits for the timeline's slice, because the guard refuses a pin for a block it does not judge. The pin file `timelineNavigationMembers-8654.test.tsx` is ready.

## Measurements (before any edit, on the unchanged renderer)

**`object-tree`** (pointer `5909523766`):
- `objectui validate` / `safeValidateSchema` on a `staticData`-only tree with no `objectName` gave `invalid_type` at `objectName`. The spec row accepted the same tree. Through `SchemaRenderer` it drew all three rows. The page validator raised `missing-required-prop` (error) on `objectName` and `unknown-prop` on `staticData`.
- `filter` narrowed the inline rows.
- `navigation: { mode: 'drawer' }` opened the record overlay. With the key absent, nothing opened.
- All 33 behavioural rows of the new pin passed on the unchanged renderer, and only the 4 registration rows were red.

**`object-map`**:
- `mapStyle` replaces the demo tiles. (Its precedence against `map.style` is ruled and changed in round 2; see the section below.)
- `enableClustering: true` clusters 2 nearby markers into one cluster. Absent, 2 markers stay 2. `false` keeps 120 markers unclustered, where absent clusters them.
- `navigation`: `drawer`, `modal` and `popover` open the record. `new_window` and `openNewTab` call `window.open('/store/record/m1', '_blank')`. `split`, `page`, `none`, an absent key and a mode-less block open nothing. `none` outranks `openNewTab`.
- All 29 behavioural rows passed on the unchanged renderer, and only the 2 registration rows were red.

**`UIActionSchema.size`**: a group MEMBER and an `action:button` draw identical classes for each size: `default` / `md` give `h-10 px-4`, `sm` gives `h-9 px-3`, `lg` gives `h-11 px-8`, and `icon` gives `h-10 w-10`. The old type refused `default` and `icon` (TS2322).

## The `ObjectTreeSchema` mirror (rides here, by measurement)

The pointer's measurement is a public-door reach. It is in the claimed file surface and the same family, so the mirror moves in this PR:
- `objectName` is optional, behind the record-source refinement the map and gantt mirrors carry.
- `data` is typed `ViewData`.
- `staticData` is declared.
- `tree` and `navigation` take the spec's `TreeConfigSchema` / `NavigationConfigSchema` by reference.

⚠️ The node's `dataSource` binding is **not** counted as a record source here. The tree's registration is not gate-wrapped, so a binding reaches nothing. `requireRecordSource` gained a `binding: 'not-read'` option for exactly this, and its message then names only the three rungs. `ObjectTree` now reads `navigation` without a cast. The ledgers that re-derive this moved with it: `SPEC_DERIVED_PAIRS` +1 and the imported-defaults `IMPORTED` list +1. The 9550 barrel pin row for `objectName` is `string | undefined`. The 8655 typed-schema pin's two "stays undeclared" rows flipped to declared, as its own 17.5.0 note predicted.

- **`object-map`:** `map`, `data`, `staticData`, `filter`, `sort`, `navigation` are in one new file, `packages/plugin-map/src/__tests__/objectMapInputs-11168.test.tsx`. `dataSource` PROMOTES `ObjectMap.elementDataSource.test.tsx`, after reading it end to end (binding object, view filter/sort, AND-ing, the unresolvable view, the unmapped `limit`, ascending default).

## `object-map.mapStyle` precedence: ruled A, the renderer follows the spec (round 2)

The installed 17.5.0 describe reads 「MapLibre style URL or spec, overriding the public demo tiles. Read before `map.style`; NOT the base node `style`, which is an inline CSS record」. The renderer read a `style` inside the `map` block first (`getMapConfig` returned `style: config.style || style`), so a map writing both drew `map.style`. The seat ruled option A (record `5926309662`, under 协议为基准).
- `getMapConfig`'s declared-block path now returns the same `mapStyle || map.style` the flat path does.
- The registration's `mapStyle` description is the spec's describe verbatim, and a pin row holds it equal to the installed row's.
- Pinned both ways through the real `SchemaRenderer`: both written ⇒ `mapStyle` draws; only `map.style` ⇒ it draws; only `mapStyle` ⇒ it draws; neither ⇒ the demo tiles (the control).
- Ablation G (prediction written first): reverting the one expression turned exactly "both written" red, with 34 green, and the file was restored to the HEAD blob.
- Census: outside tests, `mapStyle` is written only by the `ListView` / `ObjectView` flatteners, on the path with no `map` block. objectstack carries it only in the spec and its docs. So no authored producer writes both, and no stored document changes what it draws.
- Changeset `11168-map-style-precedence` (`plugin-map` patch) states the behaviour change. README, `plugin-map.mdx` and the guard's `object-map.map` pin claim now teach the spec's order.

**Round 2 head `94db25d50`**, on merge `289df609b` (`origin/main` `770cc5ba4` merged in, clean, picking up the Spec Main Shape Gate repair `47e3ce008`). Re-run there:

- lint: 0 findings on round-2 lines.

The round-1 union figures above are at `17f1664ec`.

## Acceptance notes (noted, not filed)

- The tree's flat `parentField` / `labelField` / `fields` / `defaultExpandedDepth` are still declared on `ObjectTreeSchema` and still outrank the `tree` block's members, while the 17.5.0 row refuses them flat. That is the host-composed handoff. Retiring them is a separate decision, so the README now teaches the `tree` block. Carrier: 承接者:无.
- The `object-kanban` / `object-calendar` `navigation` descriptions (objectui#8652, landed) carry the same "`openNewTab` outranks the mode" wording, which is untrue for `none`. They are outside this claim. Carrier: 承接者:无.
